text: The ghetto where they used to move the dope. The ghetto's where they used to rock and rhyme. They used to do the folks. Ghetto where they used to spit this raw. Ghetto now, some shit I never seen before. Ghetto where they used to live at. Ghetto where I spit rap. Ghetto ain't the way these dudes try to live, give back. And yo, ghetto where my brothers used to slang. Where my brothers used to hang. Where my brothers did they thang. But the ghetto's changing, projects is gone. The ghetto ain't real. Ghetto's saying nothing to songs. Ghetto ain't what you say.
